g.text: K GraphFuse | what the measured win could mean

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #111827

g.text: Measured graph-stage latency reduction: 21.28% vs native cuGraph. Whole-job impact depends on how much time that stage consumes.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #111827

g.text: Example: a 50% graph-compute share predicts a 10.64% shorter total job. Other stages, workloads and hardware must remain unchanged.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #111827

g.text: Engineering approach: equivalent finite-polynomial evaluation with a resident sparse GPU operator. The ten-step benchmark has zero truncation.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #111827

g.text: Application gains are potential. Weighted/directed ranking, changing seeds, nonlinear models, service load, cost and energy require separate validation.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #111827

g.text: Model: total time ratio = (1 − f) + f / 1.270346. No global SOTA, universal accuracy or complete bottleneck-elimination claim.
